<description>
Adds sandboxing options that `bitcoind` doesn't need to be exempt from, namely kernel/clock/hostname protection, namespace, realtime and SUID restrictions, a socket address family allowlist, and a system call filter and empty capability bounding set.

Also switches the `ExecStartPre` `chgrp` from "!" to "+", since "!" only lifts `User=`/`Group=`, and the new syscall filter and capability bounding set would block it otherwise.
</description>

<commits>
ad2600eb3e contrib/init: add systemd hardening directives
</commits>

<files>

(test/bench/ci lines: 50)
</files>

<patch>
diff --git a/contrib/init/bitcoind.service b/contrib/init/bitcoind.service
index 1845208cbb..e971d45fac 100644
--- a/contrib/init/bitcoind.service
+++ b/contrib/init/bitcoind.service
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@ ExecStart=/usr/bin/bitcoind -pid=/run/bitcoind/bitcoind.pid \
                             -shutdownnotify='systemd-notify --stopping'
 
 # Make sure the config directory is readable by the service user
-ExecStartPre=!/bin/chgrp bitcoin /etc/bitcoin
+ExecStartPre=+/bin/chgrp bitcoin /etc/bitcoin
 
 # Process management
 ####################
@@ -82,5 +82,53 @@ MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
 # Restrict ABIs to help ensure MemoryDenyWriteExecute is enforced
 SystemCallArchitectures=native
 
+# Make kernel tunables in /proc and /sys read-only.
+ProtectKernelTunables=true
+
+# Deny explicit kernel module loading.
+ProtectKernelModules=true
+
+# Deny access to the kernel log ring buffer.
+ProtectKernelLogs=true
+
+# Mount the control group hierarchy read-only.
+ProtectControlGroups=true
+
+# Deny changes to the system clock.
+ProtectClock=true
+
+# Deny changes to the hostname.
+ProtectHostname=true
+
+# Hide processes owned by other users in /proc.
+ProtectProc=invisible
+
+# Deny creation of new namespaces.
+RestrictNamespaces=true
+
+# Deny acquiring realtime scheduling.
+RestrictRealtime=true
+
+# Deny setting the set-user-ID and set-group-ID bits on files.
+RestrictSUIDSGID=true
+
+# Prevent changes to the execution domain (personality).
+LockPersonality=true
+
+# Remove IPC objects owned by the service user when it stops.
+RemoveIPC=true
+
+# Only allow IP, UNIX and netlink sockets. Netlink is used for
+# NAT-PMP/PCP gateway discovery and getifaddrs().
+RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX AF_NETLINK
+
+# Only allow system calls used by typical system services, minus
+# privileged ones.
+SystemCallFilter=@system-service
+SystemCallFilter=~@privileged
+
+# Drop all capabilities.
+CapabilityBoundingSet=
+
 [Install]
 WantedBy=multi-user.target

</patch>
